one_liner: Bright Data offers a REST API (Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper, Scraper Studio) with bearer API key auth, a free tier of 5,000 monthly credits, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses a Bearer API key from account settings. Proxy access uses a username and password. OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, public clients, open dynamic client registration, single 'mcp' scope) is documented only for the MCP server, not the main REST API, so API_KEY is primary.
access_notes: New accounts get 5,000 free credits per month. An API key is issued at signup (default key created automatically). The MCP docs also say new users get free credit for testing and then pay as you go.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Free credits are a monthly allowance; the MCP server may require an Admin-permission API key.

evidence.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API. We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.
